page_title: HEI 2-4 HOF | Heidenheim v Hoffenheim 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Robert Hartmann is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
90+7' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90+2' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' Here is a change. Bazoumana Toure is going off and Moritz Volz gives the last tactical orders to Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim).
87' Here's the change. Fisnik Asllani leaves the pitch and Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.

87' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) will deliver the corner kick.
84' 2 - 4 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:4.
84' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

84' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
83' Robert Hartmann blows for a foul after Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Heidenheim win a free kick.

78' 1 - 4 GOAL! Superb work from Bazoumana Toure, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim), who beats Diant Ramaj with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 1:4.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is replacing Andrej Kramaric.
77' Moritz Volz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) replacing Albian Hajdari.
75' What an opportunity! Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) disappointed the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from inside the box against the right post!
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jan Schoppner departs the field of play to be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
72' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Heidenheim players look gutted.
71' The Heidenheim players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Hartmann makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
70' Goal! Christian Conteh (Heidenheim) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 2:3.
67' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) comes onto the pitch for Wouter Burger.
63' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Niklas Dorsch is replaced by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim).
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Omar Haktab Traore can be given a rest.

63' 1 - 3 GOAL! Hennes Behrens launches a long throw into the box which evades everyone except Luca Kerber (Heidenheim), who gleefully thumps the ball into the net from close range. That makes it 1:3.
61' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
61' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
59' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

56' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim will have a throw-in.
49' 0 - 3 Goal! Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:3.

49' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Diant Ramaj makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
47' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
46' Half-time substitution. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is replaced by Sirlord Conteh.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Christian Conteh comes on in place of Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+5' 0 - 2 The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Robert Hartmann to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Hoffenheim players can finally celebrate. Goal - 0:2! Andrej Kramaric tees up Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Diant Ramaj.
45+1' Attention! Referee Robert Hartmann straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
45+1' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Total attempts – 4:5. 0:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
40' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
39' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle and it's Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
37' Hoffenheim earn a corner.
36' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
35' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
31' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Heidenheim for a penalty. Play continues.

26' 0 - 1 Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Fisnik Asllani. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the top left corner via the woodwork. 0:1!
16' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
11' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
8' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is adjudged offside.
6' The ball goes behind for a corner. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

1' What an opportunity! Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Robert Hartmann is the one to supervise the game today.
